description: Find a blank government form in the Emboss library by name or number, ready to fill. Search the Emboss library of blank government forms by name, number, alias or place (w9, W-9, form w 9 and taxpayer identification all find the same form). When a form belongs to a state or country, say so in the query or pass region or country. Leave query empty and pass region, country or category to list every form that fits. Returns each match's slug, title, agency, number, place, category, edition and page count, plus a note when the library holds a different year than the one asked for or needs to know the state. Send the whole query once, and do not search as the user types: each search spends one of the account's rate-limit slots. Up to 20 matches come back at a time (limit sets up to 50); when next_cursor is set, pass it as cursor for the next ones. Pass a slug as create_form's library argument to start from that form. Free.

examples.query: IRS Form W-9 request for taxpayer identification number

name: find_form
title: Find a blank government form
